name: Deconstruct Parameter
description: Deconstruct acoustic parameters. Connect the params of Analyse Impulse Response and pick one in select, to get its name, values, frequencies and overall value as plain lists, or leave it on all.

inputParameters.name: param
inputParameters.description: AcousticParameter (AP) objects, e.g. the params of Analyse Impulse Response.

inputParameters.name: select
inputParameters.description: Which parameter to output: all (default), or one of EDT, T20, T30, C50, C80, D50, DRR, Ts, STI, G, which gives its values and frequencies as plain lists. A value list is added when it is not connected.

outputParameters.name: name
outputParameters.description: Name of the acoustic parameter (one per parameter when select is all).

outputParameters.name: values
outputParameters.description: Values of the acoustic parameter, one per frequency band (one branch per parameter when select is all).

outputParameters.name: overall
outputParameters.description: Overall value of the acoustic parameter (one per parameter when select is all).
